scope: Appearance-only settings from inspected non-fisheye perspective exports: residential surface colors, a No Frills facade panel, and the 364 Water Street stone pier. Existing source IDs, massing, roof shapes, roads, collision, and safe-setback garden geometry remain unchanged.
calibrationLimit: Perspective exports reuse the existing experimental fisheye calibration. They support visible surface/material categories, not surveyed dimensions or colorimetry.

records.label: R13
records.name: 364 Water Street office
records.observation: The 0714 source shows a broad pale stone/concrete pier between the narrow north/left vertical glazed bay and the horizontal ribbon windows. In the final R13 frontage, the ribbons and lower glazed band cross this pier. The profile runs t=0 south/right to t=1 north/left; the pier spans about t=.62-.84, leaving the separate vertical strip beginning near .845 visible.
changes: Add a bounded facade panel at t=.73, width fraction .22 (span .62-.84), bottom 0 m, height 20.2 m (the existing profile height), and .30 m outset, using the existing wall color #b9ae96. This hides the incorrect crossing window ribbons locally without changing footprint or massing.
limitations: The source is one upward oblique perspective view, so pier width and material match are visual estimates.
The 20.2 m panel height follows the existing building profile, not a measured facade height.

records.label: R01
records.name: No Frills, George/Sherbrooke
records.observation: The 0582 perspective source shows the No Frills west-end facade with a broad yellow sign-bearing wall section beside pale/white cladding. Both baseline R01 views show the same mapped facade as mostly white with only a narrow yellow eave strip. The 0576 neighbor shows the yellow corner; 0588 shows a separate pale return, which is excluded.
changes: Append one yellow facade panel at frontage fraction 0.18, width fraction 0.36 (~12 m of the mapped ~34 m face), bottom 0.15 m, height 4.9 m, and 0.16 m outset. This is an explicit visual estimate; it leaves the pale wall remainder and does not touch the side return.

Set the existing NO FRILLS wordmark to 9 m wide at t=0.15, sign center height 3.75 m, and 0.8 m board height only when the source profile still has its original 12 m / t=0.18 / 4.3 m settings. This keeps the lettering span (~t=0.017–0.283) beside the worker badge (~t=0.308–0.332) at the same vertical center.
limitations: The perspective export reuses experimental fisheye calibration and is oblique, so pixel width does not directly establish mapped frontage proportion.
Panel span is a conservative estimate anchored by the existing 12 m sign span; color is an appearance estimate under dusk lighting.
The baseline has substantial tree occlusion.
